brand._comment: Their logo and site are monochrome charcoal (#292929) and white, so themeColor is that charcoal, deepened. The accent is the aged brass of the pendant lights in their Burradoo home, and accent2 is the recycled-brick red of the chimneys at Burradoo and Burrawang. Neither is a published brand colour.

logo._comment: Their own logo, pinczibuilderslogo.webp (274x83): white PINCZI / BUILDERS lettering on a charcoal wood-grain panel. I made the panel transparent, so the white lettering sits on the dark header without a grey box, and trimmed the empty margin. The lettering is unchanged. The original is kept as assets/logo-pinczi-original.png.

faq.q: Do you only build in the Southern Highlands?
faq.a: Yes. We've worked exclusively in the Southern Highlands for over two decades. We're based in Bowral, and our work is all across the district.

faq.q: Can you help before we have plans?
faq.a: Yes. We can be involved from the early stages. We work closely with draughting professionals, architects and landscape designers, and we can help with council submissions and with organising power and water.

faq.q: Do you do renovations and additions?
faq.a: Yes. Alterations, refurbishments and additions to existing homes are a big part of our work, alongside custom new homes.

faq.q: Do you take on commercial work?
faq.a: Yes, medium-scale commercial sites. We've completed several, including Oxley College Junior School and Reekie's Tyres and More.

faq.q: Can you do the driveway, fencing and landscaping too?
faq.a: If you need it, yes: driveways, fences, paving, stone walls, tennis courts, pools, pavilions and stables.
Yes. Our builder's licence number is 350923C, and we're members of the Housing Industry Association. Pinczi Builders Pty Ltd, ABN 51 633 339 885.
